_comment: Max Payne 3 level sections to export as GoldSrc maps into the cs16-client gamedir. Geometry comes from each level's collision mesh (.wbd/.wbn) via mp3-rpf-tools 'cs16-export'. The decoded geometry is Rockstar IP and is NOT committed -- run scripts/import_mp3_map.py against your own Max Payne 3 install. Only this manifest and the script are tracked; the work cache (.mp3cache/) and the installed .bsp/.wad (in the gamedir) are not.
_fields: name (map/bsp name), archive (level .rpf path relative to the Max Payne 3 install root), entry (.wbd/.wbn name inside it; omit with visual). Optional: visual (bool: geometry from the level's placed .wdr drawables with real per-face UVs and one WAD texture per material -- denser than collision, crop tighter; textures the room archive lacks are auto-resolved from the level's shared/gtxd archives), scale (units/metre, default 40), thickness, crop ('xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax' in MP3 metres -- carve one room), voxel (rasterize to axis-aligned boxes of N metres -- the only way a whole level fits; smaller = more detail + brushes), max_tris, tex_scale, spawns. Collision-mode textures are assigned by face orientation: tex_floor / tex_wall / tex_ceiling are .wtd texture names from the level (auto-picked by keyword if omitted); 'texture' (a PNG path) overrides all three with one image. Lighting comes from the level's own rage_light objects (light / light_spot entities baked by hlrad): lights (bool, default true; false keeps the single auto light) and light_scale (GoldSrc brightness per RAGE intensity unit, default 15).

maps.name: mp3_vofarch
maps._note: one room, faithful per-triangle collision (best detail)

maps.name: mp3_vofarch_vis
maps._note: half the room, VISUAL mesh (.wdr): real UVs + per-material WAD

maps.name: mp3_voflobby_vis
maps._note: front slice of the grand office lobby, VISUAL mesh (.wdr). Its wall/carpet/concrete textures live in the level's shared dicts (gtxd parent + props .rpf) and are now resolved automatically -- 7 textures pulled in, none on the dev checker. lights:false -> this slice captures only 1 (dim) rage_light, so we force the bright auto-light fallback to actually see the room

maps.name: mp3_vofarch_full
maps._note: the WHOLE level, voxelized to 0.3 m boxes (blocky but complete)
